digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge noun and subcommand dispatch
propositions: Bridge noun with preview and sync subcommands must ship as functional without breaking legacy top-level reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, or doctor commands
Bridge preview verb must force dry-run engine path and perform no Jira or ticket-store mutations
Bridge sync verb must force live engine path and perform Jira and ticket-store mutations
Mode, MODE_CAPS, and gated_mode round-trip compatibility must remain intact after bridge noun introduction
No placeholder or unimplemented bridge verb (setup, check-access, fsck, status, pause, resume) may be advertised until its functional implementation and consumer migration lands
User guide, CLI reference, and release notes must describe only the staged bridge surface (preview and sync) that actually ships, preserving documentation of all legacy commands
